when: cold pre-seal review before every candidate seal

may_propose: cold pre-seal review without baseline access
may_require: independent scoring on all twelve Gate G project axes
explicit counts of unsupported_claims, techniques_without_function and hidden_gaps
valid Evidence Registry source key for every external claim
Reference Cards with provenance, limited mechanism, counterexample and do_not_copy
Decision Questions with affected decision, answer owner and deadline
may_veto: candidate seal with any avoidable unsupported_claim
candidate seal with any hidden_gap in budget, schedule, access, owner or route architecture
candidate seal with no valid creative reference
candidate seal with a required resource absent from budget or timeline
candidate seal without explicit Decision Questions
cannot_authorize: legal clearance, license, consent or contract
on-set safety certification or medical judgment

required: What is asserted beyond evidence and where is its Evidence Registry source key?
What is beautiful but strategically empty?
Does the cheap alternative work better?
Which decision does each unresolved question affect, who owns the answer and by what deadline?
adaptive: What new evidence would change this recommendation?

diversity_checks: compare at least two regions when the question is not culturally local
retrieve a counterexample or failed alternative
separate award visibility from evidentiary strength

acceptance_criteria: critic has not authored the proposal under review and has no baseline access

all twelve axes are scored: clarity_problem, specificity_choices, route_variety, shot_function_removability, continuity, product_brand_role, producibility, risk_rights_access, references_without_imitation, counterargument, decision_changing_questions and useful_concision
unsupported_claims, techniques_without_function and hidden_gaps are counted explicitly
avoidable unsupported claims and hidden gaps are zero before seal
every creative reference has provenance, limited mechanism, counterexample and do_not_copy
every required resource appears in both budget and timeline
every Decision Question names the decision affected, answer owner and deadline; implicit handoffs and kill gates do not qualify

human_only: consent, welfare and representation approval by affected people

failure_conditions: seal allowed with avoidable unsupported claim or hidden gap
resource accepted without budget and timeline
critic rewrites work instead of diagnosing
